stories.title: Apple announces touchscreen MacBook Pro with OLED display
stories.take: Apple finally ships the touchscreen Mac it long said it would never make — OLED is the draw, and the $2,899 starting price is the reckoning.

stories.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
stories.take: Ahead of its planned IPO, Anthropic is lifting the curtain on how customers actually spend on its models — an ROI story for enterprise buyers.

stories.title: Google AI gets cagey when asked who won the 2020 elections
stories.take: Google's AI hedges on the 2020 result inside the US and gets more forthright outside it — a midterm-week reminder of how uneven election answers still are.

stories.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
stories.take: A new developer platform lets businesses plug their services straight into Google's AI experiences, changing how apps get discovered.

stories.title: Amazon turns its most capable smart speaker into a smart camera, too
stories.take: The Echo Studio with Home Camera, $30 more, can now 'see and understand' what is in front of it — best sound, new eyes.

stories.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
stories.take: With permission, Chrome can pull flight confirmations, tracking and order details from your inbox to fill forms for you.

stories.title: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
stories.take: The PHP scare faded from the feed, but Wiz says cleanup from two critical bugs in the language behind much of the web is far from over.

stories.title: Xreal Aura is a new wired headset powered by Android XR
stories.take: Xreal's Aura starts at $1,279, is wired by design, and launches with multiple XR-specific apps.

stories.title: Comcast Advertising Reveals Insights Amid Record-Breaking Midterm Political Ad Spend
stories.take: Record midterm political spend is flooding TV — Comcast's pitch is that reaching the right audiences matters more than sheer volume.

stories.title: Consumers Aren’t Ready to Let AI Do Their Holiday Shopping Yet
stories.take: Surveys say few shoppers trust AI agents to buy on their behalf yet — discovery help yes, checkout handover no.

stories.title: AI Won’t Replace Creatives, But It Can Multiply Their Output
stories.take: At Brandweek's Clubhouse, OpenArt's workshops made the multiplier case: AI as output amplifier for creatives, not a replacement.

stories.title: How Urban Outfitters finds the right campus fit with college marketing
stories.take: UO's Game Day tour wraps at Rutgers this weekend, building on a back-to-campus push that doubled as the brand's first major college play.

stories.title: ShopMy Taps Ex-Trade Desk Vet Jed Dederick as CRO to Scale Creator Commerce
stories.take: ShopMy is importing programmatic scale and measurement into creator commerce, starting with a pay-for-performance product it is wary of calling ads.

stories.title: 7-Eleven Bets on Korean Food and Drama with a Spicy New Social Miniseries
stories.take: 7-Eleven leans into Korean culture's popularity with a social miniseries built to sell its K-food lineup.

stories.title: Will Instagram's 90-minute videos make it impossible to switch off from socials?
stories.take: Instagram testing 90-minute videos blurs the line between social feed and TV — and makes logging off even harder.

stories.title: Ernie Johnson says he's stepping away from 'Inside the NBA' following the 2026-27 season
stories.take: Johnson, 70, will leave after 37 years hosting the staple of NBA coverage — the end of an era for the show.

stories.title: Tyrese Haliburton becomes latest injured NBA star: Pacers guard will miss time with hamstring strain
stories.take: Haliburton missed all of last season with an Achilles tear and is back on the shelf after only four games.

stories.title: Celtics star Jayson Tatum says he's 'starting to feel like my old self' again after hitting game-winner
stories.take: A year and a half removed from a torn Achilles, Tatum is on an early-season tear for Boston and capped it with a game-winner.

stories.title: NBA one-week overreactions: Luka Dončić as the MVP frontrunner? Who's in the most trouble?
stories.take: One week in: Luka as early MVP frontrunner, plus injuries, hangovers and the teams already in trouble.

stories.title: How can Timberwolves survive Anthony Edwards' absence?
stories.take: Edwards needs knee surgery and could miss up to two months — Minnesota's survival plan starts with everyone else leveling up.

stories.title: Jazz big man Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) out at least six weeks
stories.take: Utah is only four games in and already thin up front, a sting made worse by the Walker Kessler move.

stories.title: Hornets to retire the jersey of Muggsy Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history
stories.take: The 5-foot-3 Bogues' No. 1 heads to Charlotte's rafters on Feb. 11, 2027.

stories.title: Biggest questions for World Series Game 5: How will the Rays get enough innings to avoid elimination (again)?
stories.take: Game 5 tonight: Milwaukee starts Jacob Misiorowski for its first title, Tampa Bay turns to Drew Rasmussen on short rest with its season on the line.

stories.title: Jacob Misiorowski's moment? MLB's most electric starter can pitch the Brewers to their first title
stories.take: Misiorowski has been good but not his usual great this postseason — Game 5 is his chance to close it out.

stories.title: 2026 MLB playoff bracket: Schedule and scores as Rays stave off World Series elimination vs. Brewers
stories.take: The Rays walked off the Brewers in extra innings in Game 4 to avoid the sweep and force tonight's Game 5.

stories.title: Yankees legend Jorge Posada reveals rift with team: 'I don't feel welcome when I go there'
stories.take: The four-time champion catcher from the Torre dynasty says he does not feel welcome back in the Bronx.

stories.title: Jackson Chourio just showing off now as the face of the Brewers as Crew creeps closer to World Series title
stories.take: Chourio's four-hit Game 3 made him the youngest with a four-hit World Series game since Joe Garagiola in 1946.

stories.title: Fed holds interest rates steady in last decision before midterms
stories.take: The Fed left rates unchanged; Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role in pausing hikes despite inflation still above 3%.

stories.title: Trump rages at Alaska Democrat who reportedly recruited man with similar name as Republican opponent – live
stories.take: Citing NYT reporting, Trump calls Mary Peltola's alleged recruitment of a second Dan Sullivan 'illegal' and seeks her disqualification from Alaska's Senate race.

stories.title: Israel election results live: Netanyahu bloc loses majority as most ballots counted
stories.take: With most ballots counted, Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition bloc both fall short of the 61 seats needed to govern, while Palestinian parties make big gains.

stories.title: Spain’s Sánchez declares three days of mourning after at least 68 killed in Toledo train crash
stories.take: A Madrid-to-Seville high-speed train ran into the back of another near Toledo, knocking two carriages off the track in Spain's second deadly crash in 10 months.

stories.title: FDA scientists opposed Trump administration’s move to ease peptide access
stories.take: The plan to loosen rules on unproven peptide drugs, favored by RFK Jr., faced fierce pushback from FDA scientists.

stories.title: ‘A revolution in slow motion’: is Arizona’s wealthiest district finally done with Trump?
stories.take: Dissatisfaction with the Trump agenda has put Arizona's most affluent, fiercely contested House district in play for the midterms.

stories.title: New study estimates 75% of deceased ex-NFL players had brain disease CTE
stories.take: The study of 2,362 players who died in 2008–2023 estimates about three in four had CTE.

stories.title: Putin hails Elon Musk’s ‘genius’ amid plans for Russian version of Starlink
stories.take: Putin praised Musk and said Russia plans its own Starlink-style satellite system to support attacks on Ukraine.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta, the fiery and resolute activist who helped launch the nation's first enduring union for poor farmworkers, dies
stories.take: Huerta, 96, co-founded the United Farm Workers with Cesar Chavez and was the movement's emotional compass for decades.

stories.title: 'Star Wars' executive Kathleen Kennedy to produce L.A.'s 2028 Summer Olympics ceremonies
stories.take: The veteran 'Star Wars' and 'Jurassic Park' producer will lead the creative team for LA28's opening ceremonies.

stories.title: New poll shows billionaire tax falling behind as election nears
stories.take: Support for California's first-in-the-nation wealth tax is waning with less than a week before Election Day.

stories.title: ‘My whole life got destroyed:’ Fresno father, 49 years in the United States, suddenly deported
stories.take: Luis Arreguin, a father of four who lived in the US for 49 years, was sent to Mexico by ICE in just 16 days.

stories.title: For LA fire survivors awaiting federal disaster aid, the midterms could be key
stories.take: Long-term recovery from the LA fires depends on federal funding — and FEMA is signalling less support for states.

stories.title: SoCal man sentenced after violent drive ends in deadly crash into teens on bikes
stories.take: A Ventura County man got 27 years to life after driving into a group of bicyclists and killing a 16-year-old.

stories.title: Teens work, drive and pay taxes. But should they vote? This California city will soon decide
stories.take: Culver City will decide whether 16-year-olds can vote locally — supporters say teens who work and pay taxes deserve a say.

stories.title: This AI Expert Argues We're Underestimating AI's Productivity Impact — With Ethan Mollick
stories.take: Mollick's answer: the productivity gains are real, but they only become organizational gains when companies redesign how work is divided — something most firms have lost the muscle for over 30 years • Reasoning breakthroughs arrived 5–10 years ahead of forecasts, and superforecasters keep underestimating the curve • Dallas Fed figures discussed put US labor productivity growth at about 2.4% annualized — solid, not yet revolutionary • On jobs: senior developer demand is up as roles shift from writing code to managing code-writing, and the transition needs real safety nets

stories.title: Wendy’s Jumps on Report Trian Offers to Buy for $1.4 Billion
stories.take: Wendy's shares surged about 14% on reports Nelson Peltz's Trian offered roughly $1.4 billion to take the chain private • Trian has circled a deal since May, again in August, as a long-time shareholder • Analyst Michael Halen reads the bid as a vote of confidence in CEO Bob Wright and CFO Steve Sarula's turnaround team, not a Peltz takeover of operations • The turnaround focus: operations, product quality, everyday value and marketing, with Burger King's high-single-digit sales comeback as the benchmark
